Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 18403 of 2024

Counsel for Applicant :- Archana Agrawal,Mazhar Shakeel
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the State.
2. The instant application under Section 482 has been has been filed by the applicant with the
prayer to quash the entire proceeding of the charge-sheet dated 22.05.2023 (Charge-sheet No. 100
of 2023), in Case Crime No. 13 of 2023, under Sections 323, 504, 506, 420 of I.P.C., Police Station -
Gonda, District - Aligarh, as well as impugned cognizance as well as summoning order dated
04.10.2023 as well as entire proceedings of case no. 1935 of 2023 (State vs. Govind and another),
pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Iglas, Aligarh.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties, this Court finds that it is not a fit case for quashing the entire proceedings in the aforesaid case.

5. However, on the request of learned counsel for the appellant, it is directed that in case appellant appears and surrenders before the court below within 60 days from today and applying for regular bail, his bail application shall be considered as per judgement and order of Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, judgement dated 11.7.2022.
6.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 60 days, the applicant shall not be arrested in the aforesaid case, if not already arrested.
7. However, in case, the applicant does not appears before the court below within the aforesaid period, coercive action shall be taken against him.
8. It is made clear that the applicant will not be granted any further time by this Court for surrendering before the court below as directed above.

opennyai_summary.decision:
4. This application is dismissed.
5. However, on the request of learned counsel for the appellant, it is directed that in case appellant appears and surrenders before the court below within 60 days from today and applying for regular bail, his bail application shall be considered as per judgement and order of Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, judgement dated 11.7.2022.
6.
For a period of 60 days, the applicant shall not be arrested in the aforesaid case, if not already arrested.
7. However, in case, the applicant does not appears before the court below within the aforesaid period, coercive action shall be taken against him.
8. It is made clear that the applicant will not be granted any further time by this Court for surrendering before the court below as directed above.
